facility_roles.note: Start: the 2018 installation of the Proof-of-Principle set-up at LNGS.
facility_roles.quote: The first phase of the experiment is the SABRE Proof of Principle (PoP), a single 5kg crystal detector operated in a liquid scintillator filled vessel at Laboratori Nazionali del Gran Sasso (LNGS).

intervals.label: proposal (twin NaI(Tl) detectors at LNGS and SUPL)
intervals.note: Year of the earliest SABRE collaboration paper read (January 2016), which names LNGS as the site of the northern detector; no proposal or approval date is published in the sources read.
intervals.quote: The SABRE experiment aims to shed light on this controversy by detecting the annual modulation in the same target material as DAMA with twin detectors at LNGS in Italy and at SUPL in Australia.

intervals.label: Proof-of-Principle (PoP) installation at LNGS
intervals.note: Installation of the PoP setup in LNGS Hall C started in 2018 and was still ongoing in the 2018 SABRE project paper ('data taking is foreseen in 2019', arXiv:1806.09340); the crystal NaI-33 arrived at LNGS on 6 August 2019 (arXiv:2012.02610). End year approximate.
intervals.quote: The PoP installation is underway with the goal of running in 2018 and performing the first in situ measurement of the crystal background and testing the veto efficiency, thus validating the SABRE concept.

intervals.label: PoP and PoP-dry runs with the crystal NaI-33 (prototype data taking)
intervals.note: PoP with the liquid-scintillator veto in 2020 and PoP-dry (passive shielding) in 2021-2022; the last PoP-dry data were taken until 25 February 2022 (arXiv:2205.13876, Sec. 2). Recorded as a prototype phase of the not yet built physics detector.
intervals.quote: The SABRE Proof-of-Principle phase was carried out in 2020-2021 at the Gran Sasso National Laboratory (LNGS), in Italy.

intervals.label: SABRE North physics detector: facilities, crystal production and installation at LNGS
intervals.note: Start is the first year of the facility set-up listed on the 2024 talk's slide; 'SABRE North ... installation at LNGS' is still described as ongoing in the SCINT2026 abstract and the February 2026 LNGS seminar slides ('Assembly of detector modules 2026-2027', 'Assembly of the detector shielding 2027'). No formal approval date is published in the sources read.

name: SABRE North
notes: external.inspire_experiment is null: INSPIRE was not consulted (its rate budget belongs to the supervised importer).

Hall: the new SABRE North experimental area is 'in the corridor between Hall B and Hall A' (2024 talk); the Atlas LNGS hall records share one approximate point, so the main placement uses site:lngs-hall-b. The PoP set-up stood in Hall C (arXiv:2105.09225).
The Proof-of-Principle (PoP, 2018-2022) is recorded as prototype phases of this experiment, not as a separate experiment: the collaboration presents it as the first phase of SABRE.

The physics detector is not yet built: the February 2026 seminar plans assembly of the detector modules in 2026-2027, the shielding in 2027 and data taking from 2028. The SCINT2026 abstract says the first crystal grown from zone-refined powder was expected at LNGS in the first quarter of 2026.
Neither the target background nor the sensitivity is a measured result of SABRE North; the headline measured results are those of the PoP crystal NaI-33.

physics_goals.quote: The SABRE (Sodium Iodide with Active Background REjection) experiment will search for an annually modulating signal from dark matter particles in our Galaxy using an array of ultra-pure NaI(Tl) detectors
physics_goals.value: Model-independent test of the DAMA/LIBRA annual modulation with the same target material, using ultra-pure NaI(Tl) crystals and a second detector in the Southern Hemisphere

summary.plain: SABRE North is the Italian half of a twin pair of sodium-iodide dark matter detectors, being built at the Gran Sasso laboratory. It will use ultra-pure crystals of the same material as DAMA/LIBRA to test, with lower background, the yearly signal DAMA/LIBRA reports. Its twin, SABRE South, is in Australia.
summary.technical: Planned array of nine ~5 kg NaI(Tl) crystals read by Hamamatsu R11065 photomultipliers in a fully passive copper and polyethylene shield, in a new experimental area at LNGS between Hall B and Hall A; crystals grown by Radiation Monitoring Devices from zone-refined NaI powder. Proof-of-Principle phase (crystal NaI-33, 2020-2022): 1.20 +- 0.05 counts/day/kg/keV in 1-6 keV with a liquid-scintillator veto and 1.39 +- 0.02 with passive shielding only. Target background 0.5 cpd/kg/keV with zone refining (2024 talk); data taking planned from 2028.
